## NexusGeneral (Dynatrace - piloto)
SOAP responde HTTP 200 aunque falle: el error real está en la sección 2.

Pendiente: **1. API Gateway** (logs `/aws/api/*` no ingestados) y **4. Infra ECS** (métricas AWS por confirmar).

2.title: Respuestas adaptador
2.query:
fetch logs
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, "/aws/ecs/srv/") and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-adapter")
| filter contains(content, "::AUDIT::RESP::")
| parse content, "LD '::HTTPCODE::' INT:code"
| fieldsAdd outcome = if(code >= 200 and code < 300, "ok_2xx", else: if(code == 412, "business_412", else: "error"))
| summarize responses = count()

3.title: % OK (2xx)
3.query:
fetch logs
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, "/aws/ecs/srv/") and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-adapter")
| filter contains(content, "::AUDIT::RESP::")
| parse content, "LD '::HTTPCODE::' INT:code"
| fieldsAdd outcome = if(code >= 200 and code < 300, "ok_2xx", else: if(code == 412, "business_412", else: "error"))
| summarize value = round(100.0 * countIf(outcome == "ok_2xx") / count(), decimals: 2)

4.title: % 412 (negocio)
4.query:
fetch logs
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, "/aws/ecs/srv/") and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-adapter")
| filter contains(content, "::AUDIT::RESP::")
| parse content, "LD '::HTTPCODE::' INT:code"
| fieldsAdd outcome = if(code >= 200 and code < 300, "ok_2xx", else: if(code == 412, "business_412", else: "error"))
| summarize value = round(100.0 * countIf(outcome == "business_412") / count(), decimals: 2)

5.title: % error
5.query:
fetch logs
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, "/aws/ecs/srv/") and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-adapter")
| filter contains(content, "::AUDIT::RESP::")
| parse content, "LD '::HTTPCODE::' INT:code"
| fieldsAdd outcome = if(code >= 200 and code < 300, "ok_2xx", else: if(code == 412, "business_412", else: "error"))
| summarize value = round(100.0 * countIf(outcome == "error") / count(), decimals: 2)

6.title: RESPUESTAS ADAPTADOR EN EL TIEMPO
6.query:
fetch logs
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, "/aws/ecs/srv/") and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-adapter")
| filter contains(content, "::AUDIT::RESP::")
| parse content, "LD '::HTTPCODE::' INT:code"
| filter isNotNull(code)
| fieldsAdd code = toString(code)
| makeTimeseries responses = count(), by: { code }

7.title: ERRORES ADAPTADOR POR CLUSTER
7.query:
fetch logs
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, "/aws/ecs/srv/") and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-adapter")
| filter contains(content, "::AUDIT::RESP::")
| parse content, "LD '::HTTPCODE::' INT:code"
| fieldsAdd outcome = if(code >= 200 and code < 300, "ok_2xx", else: if(code == 412, "business_412", else: "error"))
| filter outcome == "error"
| parse aws.log_group, "'/aws/ecs/srv/' LD:cluster 'ws-'"
| makeTimeseries errors = count(), by: { cluster }

8.title: RESPUESTAS ADAPTADOR POR SERVICIO
8.query:
fetch logs
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, "/aws/ecs/srv/") and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-adapter")
| filter contains(content, "::AUDIT::RESP::")
| parse content, "LD '::HTTPCODE::' INT:code"
| fieldsAdd outcome = if(code >= 200 and code < 300, "ok_2xx", else: if(code == 412, "business_412", else: "error"))
| parse content, "LD 'X-Name=' LD:channel ','"
| parse content, "LD 'X-Referer=' LD:referer ','"
| fieldsAdd service = splitString(referer, "-")[3]
| summarize responses = count(),
    ok_2xx = countIf(outcome == "ok_2xx"),
    business_412 = countIf(outcome == "business_412"),
    error = countIf(outcome == "error"),
    by: { service, channel }
| fieldsAdd pct_error = round(100.0 * error / responses, decimals: 2)
| sort error desc, responses desc
| limit 200

9.title: ADAPTADORES EN USO
9.query:
fetch logs
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, "/aws/ecs/srv/")
| summarize events = count(), by: { aws.log_group }
| sort events desc

10.title: ERRORES DE MAPEO
10.query:
fetch logs
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, "/aws/ecs/srv/")
| filter contains(content, "GenericExceptionMapper") and contains(content, "HttpCode::")
| parse content, "LD 'Exception:' SPACE? INT:code"
| filter code != 504
| parse content, "LD 'Exception:' LD '::' SPACE? LD:message ' .'"
| parse content, "LD '3=' LD:field SPACE? '::HEAD::'"
| parse content, "LD 'X-Name=' LD:channel ','"
| parse content, "LD 'X-Referer=' LD:referer ','"
| fieldsAdd service = splitString(referer, "-")[3]
| summarize total = count(), by: { code, message, field, service, channel }
| sort total desc
| limit 1000

11.title: TIMEOUTS ADAPTADOR (504)
11.query:
fetch logs
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, "/aws/ecs/srv/")
| filter contains(content, "GenericExceptionMapper") and contains(content, "HttpCode::")
| parse content, "LD 'Exception:' SPACE? INT:code"
| filter code == 504
| parse content, "LD 'X-Name=' LD:channel ','"
| parse content, "LD 'X-Referer=' LD:referer ','"
| fieldsAdd service = splitString(referer, "-")[3]
| summarize total = count(), by: { service, channel }
| sort total desc
| limit 1000

12.title: RQUIDS CON ERROR 4XX/5XX
12.query:
fetch logs
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, "/aws/ecs/srv/") and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-adapter")
| filter contains(content, "::AUDIT::RESP::")
| parse content, "LD '::HTTPCODE::' INT:code"
| fieldsAdd outcome = if(code >= 200 and code < 300, "ok_2xx", else: if(code == 412, "business_412", else: "error"))
| filter outcome == "error"
| parse content, "LD 'X-RqUid=' LD:rquid ','"
| parse content, "LD 'X-Name=' LD:channel ','"
| parse content, "LD 'X-Referer=' LD:referer ','"
| fieldsAdd service = splitString(referer, "-")[3]
| parse content, "LD '\"system\":\"' LD:error_system '\"'"
| parse content, "LD '\"message\":\"' LD:error_message '\"'"
| fields timestamp, rquid, service, channel, code, error_system, error_message
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 200

14.title: % rechazo al canal (M)
14.query:
fetch logs
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, "/aws/ecs/srv/") and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-mngr")
| filter contains(content, "<caracterAceptacion>")
| summarize value = round(100.0 * countIf(contains(content, "<caracterAceptacion>M</caracterAceptacion>")) / count(), decimals: 2)

15.title: ERROR LOGS
15.query:
fetch logs
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, "/aws/ecs/srv/") and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-mngr")
| filter contains(content, "[ERROR")
| makeTimeseries total_errors = count()
